note: Fact base for the Cognition.X Trades Network: 37 trade families crossed with 3 regions = 111 regional union/trade entries. International union names are real and public; LOCAL/CHAPTER NUMBERS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT LISTED — locals merge, renumber and redistrict, so every entry carries the same instruction: verify the current local with the regional building-trades or labor council before publishing. Simulation scenarios are training exercises phrased against real, publicly known sites; they teach control discipline and observation and never count as equipment certification or union credit.
